statement: CoreWeave lists NVIDIA HGX H100 (8 GPUs) at $49.24 per instance-hour on-demand and $19.71 per instance-hour spot in North America on 2026-08-05.
why: The gap between the on-demand and interruptible spot rate for the same node is the clearest public read on how tight rentable H100 capacity is at one of the largest neoclouds.

impact.mechanism: Published on-demand and spot rates for the same node set the reference cost of rented H100 capacity and reveal how much headroom the operator has to discount idle machines.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX H100 (8 GPUs) — On-Demand: '$49.24' per hour; Spot: '$19.71' per hour; Inference: '$6.16' per hour

confidence.basis: Verbatim vendor-published rates, but secondary-tier open-web evidence from a single publisher (CoreWeave) with no separately fetched corroboration, so confidence is capped at medium; the figure is also per 8-GPU instance, not per GPU.

dispersion: Spot ($19.71) is about 40% of on-demand ($49.24) and the inference tier ($6.16) is lower still, for the same 8-GPU node.
